title: Smiling Graduate with Relatives, Campus Lawn - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A group portrait captured in February 1966 featuring a smiling young woman in an academic cap and gown surrounded by six family members, likely parents and grandparents. The gathering stands outdoors under a leafy magnolia or rubber tree on an academic campus, with university brick architecture visible in the background. The family is dressed in mid-1960s winter attire, including heavy overcoats, trench coats, a fur-trimmed coat, horn-rimmed glasses, and bowties, celebrating a winter commencement milestone.
